visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright retail pharmacy. The camera pans across shelves stocked with colorful Japanese cosmetic bottles. A text overlay announces "June 2025 Issue: Recent New Japanese Cosmetic Products". A Biore "The Body" mousse wash display is shown with white and pink packaging. (2) A person's hand is shown holding a generous dollop of thick, white, creamy soap foam. The foam is held over a white bathroom sink. In the background, a purple bottle of Biore cleanser stands near the faucet. The lighting is bright and clean. (3) The scene cuts to a display of 8x4 deodorant products. These are uniquely packaged in circular, powder-compact-style containers. A hand selects one, showing the puff applicator. A marketing poster in the background features a smiling model with long dark hair. (4) The focus shifts to Biore Makeup Remover Spray in a clear bottle with purple and pink text. The bottle is held against the pharmacy shelf. Onscreen text describes its makeup-dissolving properties. The lighting remains flat and bright, typical of a retail store environment. (5) Hadabisei Color Essence Masks are displayed in vibrant pink and purple boxes. The camera then moves to the Sofina Primavista "Black" oil-control stick. Both products are featured with informative subtitles explaining their specific skincare benefits and instructions for use. (6) MQURE hair treatment products are shown, including single-use packets and larger bottles. The video concludes with a wide shot of the product shelf and a final screen featuring a QR code on a pink background, inviting viewers to check a shopping list.
